findAnswersClauseverify: Find answers to common questions about ClauseVerify.
faqA1_1: ClauseVerify is a mobile application that uses artificial intelligence to analyze contracts, helping you detect risky clauses, hidden conditions, illegal terms and missing protections before signing.
faqQ1_2: How do I create an account?
faqA1_2: Tap "Sign Up" on the login screen. Enter your email, create a password, and verify your email address via the link sent to your inbox.
faqA1_3: Yes, ClauseVerify is free to download with 1 welcome scan included. After that, you can pay per scan or subscribe to the Monthly or Pro plan. PDF reports are included with every plan.
faqA2_1:
Upload a PDF or Word file, or take clear photos of your contract with the in-app camera, up to 10 pages.

ClauseVerify reads the entire document, identifies the applicable law and checks every clause against it.

You receive a detailed report explaining each risky clause and each missing protection in plain language.
faqQ2_2: What should I upload for the best result?
faqA2_2:
For best results, provide a clear, complete copy of your contract:
• All pages of the document, in order (up to 10 pages)
• Sharp, well-lit, non-blurry text
• The full agreement rather than partial excerpts
faqA2_3: PDF files, Word documents (DOC/DOCX) and photos (JPEG/PNG), up to 10 pages per analysis. Any kind of contract works, from leases and job offers to subscriptions and purchase agreements.
faqQ2_4: Does ClauseVerify work in my country?
faqA2_4: Yes. ClauseVerify works with contracts from any country. It detects your location and lets you confirm the country before each analysis.
faqA2_5: ClauseVerify reads your entire contract, identifies the applicable law and checks each clause against it. Risky and missing clauses are flagged and explained in simple terms. ClauseVerify is a pre-analysis tool: for major decisions, we recommend reviewing the results carefully.
faqA2_6: No. ClauseVerify is a pre-analysis tool that helps you understand what you're signing. It does not replace professional legal advice.
faqQ2_7: The AI can't read my document properly. What should I do?
faqA2_7: Make sure your scan or photos are clear, well-lit and not blurry, and that all pages are included. If the problem persists, try uploading in a different format (PDF instead of photos, or the other way around).
faqQ3_1: How do I reset my password?
faqA3_1: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password". Enter your email to receive a reset link.
faqQ3_2: How do I change my plan?
faqA3_2: Go to Profile, then Upgrade / Manage Plan. Select your plan and follow the payment instructions.
faqQ3_3: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqA3_3: Subscriptions are managed through Google Play. Open the Play Store, go to Payments & subscriptions, select ClauseVerify and tap Cancel. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.
faqQ3_4: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
faqA3_4: Go to Profile, then Delete My Account. Your account, documents and analysis history will be permanently deleted from our servers within 30 days. This action cannot be undone.
faqQ4_1: The app crashes or freezes. What can I do?
faqA4_1:
• Make sure you have the latest version of the app installed.
• Restart the app and your phone.
• Check your internet connection.
• Still stuck? Contact us at Qloxinc@gmail.com.
faqQ4_2: I'm having trouble uploading or scanning my document.
faqA4_2:
• Grant the necessary camera and file-access permissions in your phone settings.
• Clean your phone's camera lens if photographing pages.
• Avoid scanning in dark or reflective environments.
• Make sure PDFs are not password-protected and have 10 pages maximum.
faqQ5_1: Is my data and document library secure?
faqA5_1: Yes. We take privacy very seriously. All data is encrypted in transit and processed securely. Your documents are only shared with the service providers needed to run the analysis, and are never used to train AI models. For details, please read our Privacy Policy.
faqA5_2: No. We never sell, exchange or rent your personal information or contract details. Your data is used solely to provide the analysis service.
faqA5_3: Yes. You can delete any analyzed document from your history at any time.
aiDisclaimerIntro: Before using ClauseVerify, please read and accept the following.
aiDisclaimerWhatIsBody: ClauseVerify is an AI-powered pre-analysis tool. It reads your contract, up to 10 pages, flags risky clauses and missing protections, and explains them in plain language. Its purpose is to help you understand what you're signing.
aiDisclaimerWhatIsNotBody: ClauseVerify does not provide legal advice and does not replace a qualified legal professional. Using the app does not create any professional or advisory relationship between you and Qlox Inc.
aiDisclaimerLimitationsBody:
The analysis is fully automated and may contain errors or omissions. Some clauses may be missed, misclassified or misinterpreted.

The applicable law is determined using your location and the contract content. This determination may be inaccurate, especially for contracts involving several countries.

Laws change and vary by region. The analysis may not reflect the most recent legal updates or every local rule.

Photos of poor quality (blurry, dark, cropped) may reduce the accuracy of the analysis.

Flagged missing protections are indicative only. Whether a protection is needed depends on your situation.
aiDisclaimerResponsibilityBody: You remain solely responsible for your decisions, including whether to sign, negotiate or refuse a contract. For important or high-value contracts, we recommend seeking professional legal advice before signing.
aiDisclaimerDataBody: Your documents are processed securely to perform the analysis, including by our AI provider, Anthropic, and are never used to train AI models. You can delete them from your history at any time. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

privacyPolicyIntro: ClauseVerify is operated by Qlox Inc., Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Qlox Inc. is responsible for the personal data processed through the app and is committed to protecting your privacy.
privacyContent1_1:
Account Information
• Email address, for account creation and access
• Subscription plan (Free Scan, Pay-Per-Scan, Monthly or Pro)
privacyContent1_2:
Uploaded Content
• Documents and contracts uploaded for AI analysis
• Related metadata (contract type, jurisdiction, format)
• Contracts may contain personal information about other parties; you confirm you are authorized to upload them
privacyContent1_3:
Location Data
• With your permission, your device's approximate location, used only to help determine the law applicable to your contract
• You can refuse or withdraw this permission at any time in your device settings
privacyContent1_4:
Usage Data
• Number of analyses performed
• Dates and times of usage
• App interactions, for performance and abuse prevention
privacyContent1_5:
Payment Information
• Payments are processed by Google Play (and the App Store, when available)
• ClauseVerify never receives or stores your card details
privacyContent2_1:
Your information is used strictly to:
• Provide AI-based contract analysis and risky clause detection
• Determine the applicable law based on your location and the contract
• Generate AI Analysis Reports
• Manage user accounts and subscriptions
• Monitor usage limits and prevent abuse
• Improve app performance and reliability
• Ensure platform security

Your documents are never used to train AI models.
privacyContent3_1:
• Uploaded documents and analysis reports are stored in your history so you can access them anytime
• You can delete any document from your history at any time
• A minimal record (report ID and date) is kept to allow QR code verification of reports
• All data is permanently deleted within 30 days of account deletion, except where retention is required by law
privacyContent4_1:
We never sell, rent or exchange your personal data or your uploaded contracts. Data may be shared only with:
• Trusted service providers (AI processing, hosting, authentication, payment processing)
• Legal authorities, if required by law
privacyContent4_2: To analyze your contract, the text and images of the documents you upload are sent to Anthropic, our AI service provider located in the United States, solely to generate your analysis. Under Anthropic's commercial terms, your documents are never used to train AI models. All service providers are bound by strict data protection obligations, and some of them may process your data outside your country; we ensure they provide an adequate level of protection.
privacyContent5_1:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
• Secure, encrypted API communication with our AI provider
• Encrypted data transmission
• Access controls and monitoring
• Abuse detection and usage limits

However, no system can be 100% secure.
privacyContent6_1:
By using ClauseVerify, you agree:
• To upload only documents you have the right to share, and to redact any information you do not wish to disclose
• Not to misuse the platform or attempt to bypass usage limits
• That AI-based results are informational only and do not constitute legal advice
privacyContent7_1:
• You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from the app, in Profile, using the "Delete My Account" option
• Your account information, uploaded documents and analysis history will be permanently deleted within 30 days, except for minimal data retained where required by law
privacyContent8_1: You can access, correct or delete your personal data, and withdraw your consent at any time. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under local law. To exercise them, contact our Privacy Officer. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or your local data protection authority.
privacyContent9_1: ClauseVerify is intended for users 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.
privacyContent10_1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the latest version.
